descriptionChirho: Qal sense of engaging in military combat or warfare, used of soldiers, armies, and attackers in battle contexts (guerrear, लड़ना/युद्ध करना, حارب, 싸우다, kupigana).
Qal sense of performing religious or cultic service, especially of women serving at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting (servir, सेवा करना, يخدم, 섬기다, kutumikia/kuhudumu).
Hifil causative sense of assembling or conscripting people for military service, used of an officer who enrolls or marshals soldiers (alistar, भरती करना, يجنّد, 징집하다, kuandikisha).
